markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (95%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class prediction [F1] on a Tier-1 surgical frozen section with all four margins called positive [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 95%, Invasive 4%, Benign 2%, Normal 0% | Strong InSitu; 4% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} (alpha 10%, 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, OOD 100%, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Unflagged despite level-3 stain degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (77%–83% similarity) [F5] | Neighbors match; Invasive contrast 72% |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 5, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.77, contribution -1.05) opposes invasion (12/20 AI spot-checked) [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.10, contribution +0.61), but unreliable (0/20 AI spot-checked) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.34, contribution +0.58) raises invasive score (20/20 spot-checked) [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (2.07, contribution +0.37), but unreliable (3/20 spot-checked) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier link (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); relies on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasion in high-risk regions 10 (68%), 7 (59%), or 9 (57%) matches Invasive contrast BACH_0391 (72% similarity).
- Severity-3 frozen-section stain degradation masks invasion (reliability AUROC 70%, ECE 5%, cells disabled, stains blocked).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 7, 9**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (68%, 59%, 57% invasive risk) to exclude focal invasion.
2. **Regions 0, 5, 10, 4**: Confirm duct confinement (0, 5, 10) and exclude stromal infiltration (4; 22% risk).
3. **Regions 0–3, 4, 7, 8–11**: Verify positive superior (108 um), lateral (215 um), medial (323 um), inferior (430 um) margins.
